title: Websites and apps: where they are based

source.name: Wikidata (CC0)
source.method: sparql:SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?article ?sitelinks ?hqLabel ?born WHERE { { SELECT ?item ?sitelinks (SAMPLE(?c) AS ?hq) (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT(STR(?bT), "|", STR(?bP)); separator=";") AS ?born) WHERE { { ?item wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q35127 } UNION { ?item wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q620615 } UNION { ?item wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q4182287 } ?item wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks ; wdt:P159 ?c . FILTER(?sitelinks > 30) ?item p:P571 ?st . ?st a wikibase:BestRank ; psv:P571 [ wikibase:timeValue ?bT ; wikibase:timePrecision ?bP ] . } GROUP BY ?item ?sitelinks HAVING(COUNT(DISTINCT ?c)=1) ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 300 } hint:Prior hint:runFirst true . OPTIONAL { ?article schema:about ?item ; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> . } SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en,mul". } } ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 160
